name: Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM)
description: Gemini Notebook is Google's notebook tool for working with your own sources; Google's site now uses this name (the notebooklm.google address redirects to notebook.google). Answers are grounded in the sources you add, and it can produce Audio Overviews and slide decks. It has a free Standard tier and higher limits through Google AI plans.
features: Higher notebook and source limits on Google AI plans
useCases: Studying and summarising your own documents
strengths: Free tier with a Google account
Included with qualifying Google Workspace and Google AI plans
limitations: Free tier: 100 notebooks per user and 50 sources per notebook
Some paid tiers add a visible watermark in India, South Korea and Vietnam

plans.name: Google AI Plus
plans.note: 200 notebooks and 100 sources per notebook. Price not captured here: see Gemini

plans.name: Google AI Pro
plans.note: 500 notebooks and 300 sources per notebook. Price not captured here: see Gemini

plans.name: Google AI Ultra (20 TB / 30 TB)
plans.note: 500 notebooks and 500 or 600 sources per notebook. Price not captured here

free.details: Standard tier by signing up with a Gmail account: 100 notebooks per user and 50 sources per notebook.

pricing.regional: Plus, Pro and Ultra browser access depends on where the corresponding Google AI plan is available. The mobile app lists supported countries separately.
notes: Also available with qualifying Google Workspace or Workspace for Education licences and through Gemini Enterprise; limits not stated for those.

verification.notes: Product active but renamed: notebooklm.google now redirects to notebook.google, titled 'Gemini Notebook', and the help page is 'Learn about Gemini Notebook's plans'. The Standard tier is free with a Gmail account; Plus, Pro and Ultra tiers come with Google AI plans (see Gemini for the Pakistan prices of Plus and Pro). Notebook and source limits per tier were not re-read.
